title: Affiliate marketing: what brand assets to give top affiliates in 2025
summary: A short LinkedIn poll-style post asking affiliate managers what brand assets they give top-performing affiliates. Dustin notes that beyond logos and banners, brands are using custom landing page templates, lifestyle photography packages and AI content generators. It poses questions rather than giving answers.

principles.text: Go beyond logos and banners: equip top affiliates with richer assets like custom landing page templates, lifestyle photography and AI content generators.
principles.quote: Beyond the basics (logos and banners), I've seen some brands creating custom landing page templates, lifestyle photography packages, and even AI-powered content generators for their partners.
